title: Privacy Policy
description: What data SignalNest collects, why, how long it is kept, and the choices available to you.
heading: Privacy Policy
body:
This policy describes what this website actually does. It collects as little as possible.

What we collect

  • Server logs. Our hosting provider records standard request data such as IP address, user agent, requested path and timestamp. This is used to serve pages, detect abuse and measure reliability.
  • Newsletter email. If you submit the newsletter form, we store the address you entered in order to send the newsletter you asked for. You can unsubscribe at any time and the address is removed.
  • Optional analytics. If analytics is enabled, we use it to count page views and understand which articles help readers. Analytics is only active when a measurement ID is configured; when it is absent, no analytics script is loaded at all.

What we do not do

  • We do not sell personal data.
  • We do not ask for accounts, passwords or payment details to read articles.
  • We do not build advertising profiles from your reading on this site.

Cookies

The site itself stores one optional preference in your browser: your light or dark theme choice. Third-party services, if you enable them, may set their own cookies. Details are in the cookie notice.

Legal basis and retention

Where the GDPR or comparable law applies, we rely on legitimate interests for server logs and security, and on your consent for the newsletter. Logs are retained for a short operational window; newsletter addresses are retained until you unsubscribe.

Your choices

You can request access, correction or deletion of your data, and you can object to processing. Use the contact page.

Configuration required before launch

The operating entity name, a monitored contact address, the hosting provider's exact retention period and, where relevant, a data protection representative must be filled in. These depend on decisions only the site operator can make.
